sourceAssessment.rationale: The revision supplies the old question's missing prerequisites: an AWS Backup-supported storage resource, an organization with all features enabled, and a backup vault and IAM role in each account. It correctly replaces trusted access with enabling the backup policy type. B and E are then uniquely correct: B enables the policy type, E creates and attaches the complete policy; A is manual, C is unrelated, and D does not distribute a backup plan. The wording distinguishes policy inheritance from prerequisites for successful protection and from trusted access for organization-wide job monitoring.

sources.evidence: Backup policy type must be enabled before policies are created and attached; attached policies merge into an effective policy, the referenced IAM role must exist in each member account, and trusted access is used for organization-wide backup, restore, and copy job monitoring.
Backup policies attach to roots, OUs, or accounts, inherit into an effective policy, and require a complete effective policy for successful backup.
Organization backup policies use resource-type or tag selection and rely on resource selection, vault, and IAM-role configuration.
AWS Backup support depends on resource type and Region; a Backup-supported storage resource must not be conflated with a native SageMaker Model.

revisionJudgment.reason: README.md requires an increment when the correct answer or question intent changes. Replacing B's trusted-access action with policy-type enablement changes the required technical action, so revision 2 and archive lineage are required.

correctAnswerAssessment.boundary: B/E distribute and apply the organization backup plan. Actual protection still depends on the stated supported storage resource and each account's complete effective policy, vault, IAM role, and resource selection; trusted access remains separate job monitoring.

nativeEdits.before: You want to enforce the same backup plan for model artifacts across multiple accounts. Which two actions are required?
nativeEdits.after: An organization in AWS Organizations has all features enabled. Across multiple accounts in that organization, model artifacts are stored in AWS Backup-supported storage resources. Each account already has the required backup vault and IAM role. You want to distribute and apply the same backup plan as an organization policy. Which two actions are required?

nativeEdits.before: Enable trusted access between AWS Backup and Organizations.
nativeEdits.after: Enable the backup policy type in the organization.

nativeEdits.before: AWS Backup requires trusted access with Organizations to use organization policies.
nativeEdits.after: Before you create and attach backup policies, you must enable that policy type in AWS Organizations.

nativeEdits.before: A backup policy can be attached to the organization root, an OU, or an account.
nativeEdits.after: When you create a complete policy that includes supported resource selection, backup rules, a vault, and an IAM role, and attach it to an OU or account, the inherited effective policy creates the plan.

nativeEdits.before: Trusted access and policy attachment make recovery controls consistent across the organization.
nativeEdits.after: Distribute plans by enabling and attaching backup policies. Keep this separate from trusted access, which is required for organization-wide job monitoring.

nativeEdits.before: Você quer impor o mesmo plano de backup para artefatos de modelo em várias contas. Quais duas ações são necessárias?
nativeEdits.after: Em várias contas de uma organização do AWS Organizations com todos os recursos ativados, os artefatos do modelo são armazenados em recursos de armazenamento compatíveis com o AWS Backup. Cada conta já possui o cofre de backup e a função do IAM necessários. Você deseja distribuir e aplicar o mesmo plano de backup como uma política da organização. Quais duas ações são necessárias?

nativeEdits.before: Habilitar o acesso confiável entre AWS Backup e Organizations.
nativeEdits.after: Habilitar o tipo de política de backup na organização.

nativeEdits.before: O AWS Backup precisa de acesso confiável com o Organizations para usar políticas da organização.
nativeEdits.after: Antes de criar e anexar políticas de backup, é necessário habilitar esse tipo de política no AWS Organizations.

nativeEdits.before: Uma política de backup pode ser anexada à raiz da organização, a uma OU ou a uma conta.
nativeEdits.after: Quando você cria uma política completa que inclui a seleção de recursos compatíveis, regras de backup, um cofre e uma função do IAM, e a anexa a uma OU ou conta, a política efetiva herdada cria o plano.

nativeEdits.before: O acesso confiável e a associação da política mantêm os controles de recuperação consistentes em toda a organização.
nativeEdits.after: Distribua os planos ativando e anexando políticas de backup. Distinga isso do acesso confiável, necessário para o monitoramento de trabalhos em toda a organização.

nativeEdits.before: Vous voulez imposer le même plan de sauvegarde aux artefacts de modèle dans plusieurs comptes. Quelles sont les deux actions nécessaires ?
nativeEdits.after: Dans plusieurs comptes d’une organisation AWS Organizations dont toutes les fonctionnalités sont activées, les artefacts de modèle sont stockés dans des ressources de stockage prises en charge par AWS Backup. Chaque compte dispose déjà du coffre de sauvegarde et du rôle IAM requis. Vous souhaitez distribuer et appliquer le même plan de sauvegarde sous forme de politique d’organisation. Quelles sont les deux actions nécessaires ?

nativeEdits.before: Activer l’accès approuvé entre AWS Backup et Organizations.
nativeEdits.after: Activer le type de politique de sauvegarde dans l’organisation.

nativeEdits.before: AWS Backup a besoin d’un accès approuvé avec Organizations pour utiliser les politiques de l’organisation.
nativeEdits.after: Avant de créer et d’attacher des politiques de sauvegarde, vous devez activer ce type de politique dans AWS Organizations.

nativeEdits.before: Une politique de sauvegarde peut être associée à la racine de l’organisation, à une OU ou à un compte.
nativeEdits.after: Lorsque vous créez une politique complète incluant la sélection des ressources prises en charge, les règles de sauvegarde, un coffre et un rôle IAM, puis l’attachez à une OU ou à un compte, la politique effective héritée crée le plan.

nativeEdits.before: L’accès approuvé et l’association de la politique permettent d’appliquer des contrôles de restauration cohérents dans toute l’organisation.
nativeEdits.after: Distribuez les plans en activant et en attachant des politiques de sauvegarde. Distinguez cela de l’accès approuvé, requis pour le suivi des tâches à l’échelle de l’organisation.

nativeEdits.before: Sie möchten für Modellartefakte in mehreren Konten verbindlich denselben Backup-Plan anwenden. Welche zwei Maßnahmen sind erforderlich?
nativeEdits.after: In einer Organisation in AWS Organizations sind alle Funktionen aktiviert. In mehreren Konten dieser Organisation werden Modellartefakte in von AWS Backup unterstützten Speicherressourcen gespeichert. In jedem Konto sind der erforderliche Backup-Tresor und die erforderliche IAM-Rolle bereits vorhanden. Sie möchten denselben Backup-Plan als Organisationsrichtlinie verteilen und anwenden. Welche zwei Maßnahmen sind erforderlich?

nativeEdits.before: Trusted Access zwischen AWS Backup und Organizations aktivieren.
nativeEdits.after: Den Richtlinientyp für Backup-Richtlinien in der Organisation aktivieren.

nativeEdits.before: AWS Backup benötigt Trusted Access mit Organizations, um Organisationsrichtlinien zu verwenden.
nativeEdits.after: Bevor Backup-Richtlinien erstellt und angehängt werden, muss dieser Richtlinientyp in AWS Organizations aktiviert werden.

nativeEdits.before: Eine Backup-Richtlinie kann der Organisationsstamm, einer OU oder einem Konto zugeordnet werden.
nativeEdits.after: Wenn Sie eine vollständige Richtlinie erstellen, die die Auswahl unterstützter Ressourcen, Backup-Regeln, einen Backup-Tresor und eine IAM-Rolle enthält, und sie an eine OU oder ein Konto anhängen, erstellt die geerbte effektive Richtlinie den Plan.

nativeEdits.before: Trusted Access und die Zuordnung der Richtlinie sorgen für einheitliche Wiederherstellungskontrollen in der gesamten Organisation.
nativeEdits.after: Verteilen Sie Pläne, indem Sie Backup-Richtlinien aktivieren und anhängen. Dies ist vom vertrauenswürdigen Zugriff zu unterscheiden, der für die organisationsweite Überwachung von Aufträgen erforderlich ist.

nativeEdits.before: Quieres exigir el mismo plan de copias de seguridad para los artefactos de modelos en varias cuentas. ¿Qué dos acciones son necesarias?
nativeEdits.after: En varias cuentas de una organización de AWS Organizations con todas las características habilitadas, los artefactos de modelo se almacenan en recursos de almacenamiento compatibles con AWS Backup. Cada cuenta ya cuenta con la bóveda de copias de seguridad y el rol de IAM necesarios. Deseas distribuir y aplicar el mismo plan de copias de seguridad como una política de la organización. ¿Qué dos acciones son necesarias?

nativeEdits.before: Habilitar el acceso de confianza entre AWS Backup y Organizations.
nativeEdits.after: Habilitar el tipo de política de copias de seguridad en la organización.

nativeEdits.before: AWS Backup necesita acceso de confianza con Organizations para utilizar políticas de la organización.
nativeEdits.after: Antes de crear y asociar políticas de copias de seguridad, debes habilitar ese tipo de política en AWS Organizations.

nativeEdits.before: Una política de copias de seguridad se puede asociar a la raíz de la organización, a una OU o a una cuenta.
nativeEdits.after: Cuando creas una política completa que incluye la selección de recursos compatibles, reglas de copia de seguridad, una bóveda y un rol de IAM, y la asocias a una OU o cuenta, la política efectiva heredada crea el plan.

nativeEdits.before: El acceso de confianza y la asociación de políticas mantienen controles de recuperación coherentes en toda la organización.
nativeEdits.after: Distribuye los planes habilitando y asociando políticas de copias de seguridad. Distingue esto del acceso de confianza, necesario para supervisar trabajos en toda la organización.

nativeEdits.before: Vuoi applicare lo stesso piano di backup agli artefatti dei modelli in più account. Quali due azioni sono necessarie?
nativeEdits.after: In più account di un’organizzazione AWS Organizations con tutte le funzionalità abilitate, gli artefatti del modello sono archiviati in risorse di archiviazione supportate da AWS Backup. Ogni account dispone già del vault di backup e del ruolo IAM necessari. Vuoi distribuire e applicare lo stesso piano di backup come policy dell’organizzazione. Quali due azioni sono necessarie?

nativeEdits.before: Abilitare l’accesso affidabile tra AWS Backup e Organizations.
nativeEdits.after: Abilitare nell’organizzazione il tipo di policy per i backup.

nativeEdits.before: AWS Backup richiede l’accesso affidabile con Organizations per utilizzare le policy dell’organizzazione.
nativeEdits.after: Prima di creare e associare policy di backup, devi abilitare quel tipo di policy in AWS Organizations.

nativeEdits.before: Una policy di backup può essere associata alla radice dell’organizzazione, a un’OU o a un account.
nativeEdits.after: Quando crei una policy completa che include la selezione delle risorse supportate, le regole di backup, un vault e un ruolo IAM, e la associ a un’OU o a un account, la policy effettiva ereditata crea il piano.

nativeEdits.before: L’accesso affidabile e l’associazione della policy rendono coerenti i controlli di ripristino in tutta l’organizzazione.
nativeEdits.after: Distribuisci i piani abilitando e associando policy di backup. Tieni distinta questa operazione dall’accesso affidabile, necessario per il monitoraggio dei processi nell’intera organizzazione.

pt.archivedBackupPolicyPrerequisitesClarifi: As condições e as explicações desta versão arquivada foram revisadas. Para recursos de armazenamento compatíveis com o AWS Backup, habilite o tipo de política de backup na organização e anexe a política. O acesso confiável é necessário para o monitoramento de trabalhos em toda a organização e deve ser distinguido da distribuição de planos. Os registros históricos de pontuação permanecem inalterados.

ko.archivedBackupPolicyPrerequisitesClarifi: 이 보관 버전의 출제 조건과 설명이 개정되었습니다. AWS Backup에서 보호할 수 있는 스토리지 리소스에 대해 조직에서 백업 정책 유형을 활성화하고 정책을 연결합니다. 신뢰할 수 있는 액세스는 조직 전체 작업 모니터링에 필요한 설정이므로 계획 배포와 구분해야 합니다. 기존 채점 기록은 변경되지 않습니다.

zh-CN.archivedBackupPolicyPrerequisitesClarifi: 此归档版本的出题条件和说明已修订。对于 AWS Backup 可保护的存储资源，请在组织中启用备份策略类型并附加策略。可信访问是组织范围作业监控所需的设置，应与计划分发区分开来。历史评分记录保持不变。

zh-TW.archivedBackupPolicyPrerequisitesClarifi: 此封存版本的出題條件與說明已修訂。針對 AWS Backup 可保護的儲存資源，請在組織中啟用備份政策類型並附加政策。信任存取是組織範圍工作監控所需的設定，應與計畫分發區分。過去的評分紀錄不會變更。

mainRefinements.before: Across multiple accounts in AWS Organizations with all features enabled, model artifacts are stored in AWS Backup-supported storage resources. Each account already has the required backup vault and IAM role. You want to distribute and apply the same backup plan as an organization policy. Which two actions are required?
mainRefinements.after: An organization in AWS Organizations has all features enabled. Across multiple accounts in that organization, model artifacts are stored in AWS Backup-supported storage resources. Each account already has the required backup vault and IAM role. You want to distribute and apply the same backup plan as an organization policy. Which two actions are required?
mainRefinements.reason: Main clarifies all-features applies to the organization, not its individual accounts; retains literal AWS Organizations.
